reference_sql:
SELECT channel_id, month, budget_eur,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY budget_eur DESC, month) AS budget_order
FROM budget_monthly
WHERE month >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND month < DATE '2026-01-01'
alternatives:
SELECT b.channel_id, b.month, b.budget_eur,
       1 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM budget_monthly b2
            WHERE b2.channel_id = b.channel_id
              AND b2.month >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND b2.month < DATE '2026-01-01'
              AND (b2.budget_eur > b.budget_eur OR (b2.budget_eur = b.budget_eur AND b2.month < b.month))) AS budget_order
FROM budget_monthly b
WHERE b.month >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND b.month < DATE '2026-01-01'

WITH budgets_2025 AS (  -- one row per channel and month of 2025
  SELECT channel_id, month, budget_eur
  FROM budget_monthly
  WHERE month >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND month < DATE '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT b.channel_id, b.month, b.budget_eur, COUNT(b2.month) + 1 AS budget_order
FROM budgets_2025 b
LEFT JOIN budgets_2025 b2 ON b2.channel_id = b.channel_id
  AND (b2.budget_eur > b.budget_eur OR (b2.budget_eur = b.budget_eur AND b2.month < b.month))
GROUP BY b.channel_id, b.month, b.budget_eur
